subject: 英語
title: should・have to・Can I ～?／Can you ～?（特訓）

questions.prompt:
次の文を、［　］の指示にしたがって書きかえよう。
Ken cleans his room.［「～しなければならない」という文に］

accepted: Ken has to clean his room.

questions.explanation: 主語が3人称単数なので has to。cleans はもとの形 clean。

I don't have to go to school today.

questions.explanation: have to の否定は don't have to。

questions.explanation: has to の否定は doesn't have to（has は have にもどす）。
